objective: Test whether persistent high-resolution token identities and a token-grid gauge expose action-discriminative change that the failed CLS sequence and pair-local correspondence branches could not preserve.
observed_evidence: ARFTR retains 85.383648% macro-F1 with 702 errors; 457 are standing/locomotion swaps.
Timestamp and actor-relative standalone sequence readers regress to 68.48%, 71.78%, 69.30%, 64.16%, and 64.22% macro-F1.
PCAR v5 improves an affine reconstruction proxy by only 0.0116% and has outer net corrections [-5,-6,+29,-6,-31].

The raw-point GIPA Phase-A smoke passed replay/cycle checks but failed survival (0.75/0.5625), actor-residual retention (0.345/0.319), held reduction, and wrong-track specificity; a new identity carrier must be tested rather than silently reusing LK tracks.

The verified 12x12 dense-token cache contains spatial detail absent from the 3x3 ARFTR inputs; FineLocalMotion improves NLL/Brier versus a repeated-coarse control but cannot be globally blended (199 rescues, 494 harms).
information_available_at_inference: optional frozen ARFTR context/logits only in the later residual integration
observable token validity, matching entropy, crop/track quality
forbidden_inputs: true labels during measurement or outer fit
oracle action choice or oracle candidate selection
outer-fold predictions reused as meta-training data

representation.persistent_slots: 144 actor-crop grid slots initialized at the anchor frame
representation.transport: adjacent-frame entropic balanced local OT with dustbin; compose assignments forward and backward instead of re-detecting independently
representation.gauge: weighted 2D similarity fit on expected token coordinates to remove common crop translation/scale; retain residual token values and coordinate residuals
channels: absolute ARFTR context in integration only
representation.reader: <=1M-parameter two-factor head; zero-initialized bounded posture and motion residuals; explicit retain_ARFTR action

phase_a_label_blind_measurement.selection: first 16 sample-ID-hash centers from the existing fixed 128-center witness; no class/error/support selection
phase_a_label_blind_measurement.then_expand: expand to all 128 witness centers only if every smoke gate passes

required_gates.finite_replay: all arrays finite; exact sample/timestamp alignment
required_gates.survival: at least 0.80 of anchor slots survive both directions on median center and >=0.65 on every smoke center
required_gates.cycle: median forward/backward coordinate closure <=1.5 grid cells and 95th percentile <=4.0
required_gates.identity: permuting frame identities increases held-token one-step prediction error by >=25% on expanded witness set
required_gates.nontriviality: persistent paths differ from repeated-anchor control on >=50% of valid slots
required_gates.source_consistency: native/downsample cache paired statistics agree within predeclared 20% relative tolerance

phase_a_label_blind_measurement.failure_action: close PTG measurement branch; do not fit a task classifier and do not enlarge the reader

phase_b_task_probe.authorization: conditional on Phase A passing; one seed only until discovery gate
phase_b_task_probe.population: all 4,977 centers; same 11 scenarios and five grouped outer folds
arms: G0 frozen ARFTR context plus availability control
G1 deterministic repeated-coarse temporal-moment control (matched to the PTG feature budget)
G2 G0 plus raw persistent token paths without gauge
G3 G0 plus PTG gauge, parity, and cycle channels (primary)

training.runtime_rule: label-blind timing smoke must project <=20 minutes; otherwise shard and stop

discovery_gates: G3 minus G2 >0 in every outer fold
NLL and Brier no worse than G0
independent replay exact to saved outputs

integration_if_discovery_passes.selection: all gate/threshold fitting strictly inside each outer training fold using fresh inner cross-fitted ARFTR and PTG predictions

promotion_gates.intervention_rate: <=0.15 unless predeclared cost evidence justifies lower

integration_if_discovery_passes.stop: any outer fold net <=0, failed lower bound, failed audit, or no positive inner utility closes PTG integration and leaves ARFTR default
